name: China Jushi Co., Ltd.
summary: China Jushi Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells fiberglass and related products in China and internationally. The company offers fiberglass mats, woven rovings, hybrid fibers, glass yarns, and electronic fabrics. It also provides fiberglass products for continuous profiles, compression molding, open molding, pipes, fabrics and mats, and other processes. The company's products are used in building and construction, infrastructure, electrical and electronic, chemical corrosion resistance, transportation, energy-saving and environmental protection, and sports and leisure applications.
